# Afrikaans playable lexicon expanded from hunspell af_ZA (LibreOffice dictionaries af_ZA @ 75f5dff8c972fff4a32e4ea8434722c277f02a3f).
# Diacritics are FOLDED to their base letter, because the Afrikaans Scrabble edition
# bears plain Latin tiles only and ignores diacritical marks. So this file lists
# playable TILE SEQUENCES, not Afrikaans orthography: 'more' is here, 'more' with a
# circumflex is not.
# Not an official tournament list.
